nodes.title: 連続するダンスの指示
widgets_values:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 9.38-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single locked-off take opens in the original framing and visual style of Picture 1. The dancer starts in the pictured pose in front of the same background. The surroundings stay in the same positions and the dancer's face and hair stay consistent. The dancer releases the opening pose, brings the arms down and shifts weight to one side, carrying the shoulders and forearms into an outward sweep. At 3.00 seconds the clothes change to {a} as the forearms continue their arc at the same speed. The dancer reverses direction into two sharp syncopated accents, then rolls the shoulders toward the camera as the elbows open. The shoulder roll brings the dancer into a brief accent with both elbows bent and palms forward near the shoulders. At 6.00 seconds the outfit becomes {b} on that accent, with the head, shoulders, elbows and palms in the same positions across the change. The palms then sweep outward together into the finishing gesture. The phrase ends in the same scene, settling into the pose and clothes in Picture 2.

overall_soundscape: Gentle fabric movement follows the larger gestures.

non_diegetic_music: One continuous 120 BPM dance-pop groove with kick, bass and claps plays from the opening beat through the final pose.

nodes.title: 元画像から中間ポーズを作る条件
中間ポーズを4.5秒に加える
使い方と必要モデル
widgets_values:
① 人物画像を選択 → ② 衣装 A・B を短い英語で指定 → ③ 実行を1回。元の服 → A → B の順に着替える9.42秒の音楽付き動画です。衣装変更の指示は約3秒・6秒。実際の時刻は生成結果によりずれます。

出力は `output/TikTokMV/`。ComfyUI 0.45.0で検証。カスタムノード不要。各生成は12 GB GPU 1枚で実行。画像条件2枚と動画・音楽を順に自動生成します。初期シードは42固定。

必要モデルは `ComfyUI/models/` 内の各フォルダーに配置します。

- [diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- [loras/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)
- [text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)
- [vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)
- [diffusion_models/minimax_h3_image_pruned_w4a8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_image_pruned_w4a8.safetensors)
- [vae/minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors)

画像は比率を保って縮小し、32px単位に揃える際に端をわずかに中央クロップします。生成した映像・音声に修復・差し替えは行いません。
